Head 3c58b29d64047465b60a1938fc3b5fb5a9d5eecb carried two blocking follow-ups, repaired in this revision. All five are fixed inside the existing allowed paths with regression tests for each reproduced case.

Repair 1 — hidden-character injection bypass: hidden and bidirectional controls are now normalized BEFORE high-severity detection, so a zero-width or bidi split payload is quarantined instead of being retained as clean text. The hidden-content finding is still raised from the original text and contentDigest still binds the exact original bytes.

Repair 2 — non-network URL acceptance: only https: and http: may enter a session. Every other scheme raises RESEARCH_SOURCE_SCHEME_DENIED, scoreSource independently returns score 0 tier rejected, and recordSearch refuses the whole batch rather than silently dropping the entry. HTTPS remains the normal path; retained plaintext HTTP is penalized, documented, and tested.

Repair 3 — resume budget widening: a resumed session binds to its own serialized plan and raises RESEARCH_RESUME_PLAN_MISMATCH on a differing supplied plan, plus RESEARCH_RESUME_STATE_INVALID for over-budget, over-ceiling, duplicate-query, duplicate-source, or impossible-quarantine state.

Repair 4 — batch atomicity: recordSearch now resolves the complete bounded batch into locals with a single commit point. A refused batch leaves sources, quarantine count, observation count, executedQueries, and remaining budget exactly unchanged, so a corrected batch can be retried against the same budget. Proven by full state equality before and after a refused mixed HTTPS + file: batch, on an empty session and on top of previously accepted state.

Repair 5 — resumable state soundness: the previous invariant bounded quarantined by the source count, but quarantined results are dropped rather than retained, so a legitimate {quarantined:5, sources:0, executedQueries:1} state rejected its own resume. observedResults is now serialized and bounds both quarantined and the retained source count. Every state() result resumes exactly, proven for the five-quarantined-zero-source case and for active and cancelled round trips.
